note: header chrome -- renders the operator's fixed brand heading and navigation vocabulary
travel progress indicator -- renders the closed set of operator-defined step numbers and step labels
search-step chrome outside the form -- renders the operator's fixed search-page heading
search-form labels -- renders the operator's fixed field-label vocabulary
search-form buttons -- renders the operator's fixed date-picker and search-action controls
origin menu -- renders the closed set of operator-defined departure-location options
destination menu -- renders the closed set of operator-defined arrival-location options
passenger-count menu -- renders the closed set of operator-defined passenger-count options
travel-class menu -- renders the closed set of operator-defined cabin-class options
